scope: Autonomous final campaign protocol; all five selected inputs available. No final PUB-05 inference has been performed at freeze.
scientific_question: Across five preselected observational regimes, when do provenance, sampler, PPC and scientific interpretation gates pass or fail?
hypothesis: Method scope varies with depth, exposure and astrophysical variability; universal interpretability is not assumed.
selection_rule: Two fixed anchors plus one high-impact long-cadence giant, one active-star short-cadence giant and one intermediate Neptune-size long-cadence system, chosen from public pre-fit characteristics.
inclusion: Confirmed transiting system; public Kepler/TESS PDCSAP FITS with measured uncertainty, TDB/BJD reference, target ID, segment and exposure; exactly three preselected products; failures remain listed.
exclusions: Nonzero mission quality flags, nonfinite time/flux/error/exposure, nonpositive measured errors; no clipping by residuals or inferred posterior quality.

acquisition_policy.duplicate_product_tiebreak: latest archived processing version within quarter; lexicographic product ID if metadata otherwise tied
acquisition_policy.failure_policy: retain target as failed_data_access if required quarters cannot be acquired; do not replace with easier target

catalog_queries.query: select kepoi_name,kepid,kepler_name,koi_period,koi_time0bk,koi_duration,koi_depth,koi_ror,koi_impact,koi_srad,koi_prad from q1_q17_dr25_koi where kepoi_name in ('K00007.01','K00001.01')

select pl_name,hostname,pl_orbper,pl_tranmid,pl_trandur,pl_trandep,pl_ratror,pl_ratdor,pl_imppar,pl_rade,st_rad,pl_orbper_reflink,pl_tranmid_reflink,pl_trandur_reflink,pl_trandep_reflink from pscomppars where pl_name in ('TrES-2 b','HD 189733 b','Kepler-4 b')
catalog_queries.use: Context only; use paired ephemerides for all newly selected targets. Catalog values are not independent posterior validation.

catalog_queries.query: select pl_name,pl_orbper,pl_tranmid,pl_trandur,pl_refname from ps where pl_name='HD 189733 b' and pl_refname like '%Baluev%'
catalog_queries.use: Paired HD189733 ephemeris/duration from Baluev et al.2015, chosen before inference for source consistency.

preprocessing.thinning: shared M5 stratified_phase_thin; phase-uniform each segment, not outcome-selected
preprocessing.detrending: none beyond public PDCSAP plus segment median; temporal misspecification may fail gate

inference.likelihood: independent heteroscedastic Normal + inferred white jitter
inference.impact_parameter_prior: b ~ Uniform(0,1); does not cover grazing b>1

replication.operational_restart_policy: An interrupted infrastructure attempt may restart under the campaign's predeclared retry policy with identical dataset/config/seeds and a new attempt ID; all attempts remain. A sampler/PPC/scientific rejection is terminal, never a trigger for resampling. Do not choose the best posterior among attempts.

seed_policy: publication.campaign_plan.seed(campaign_id, experiment='PUB-05', scenario=target slug, replicate='rep_0000', stream='inference' or 'predictive'): first32bits SHA256 canonical JSON ['campaign-seed-v1',campaign_id,experiment,scenario,replicate,stream]. Campaign namespaces are distinct; attempt/run retry identity never changes the seed.
primary_metrics: gate pass fraction with all five targets in denominator, descriptive only; missing is not a measured gate rejection
secondary_metrics: relative interval width versus transit scale
contextual catalog comparison with dependency caveat
failed_missing_policy: Every preselected system remains in output table with failure stage; no replacement or best-seed selection; missing not counted as success.
permitted_interpretation: Descriptive characterization of these five selected systems/regimes, not a population estimate or universal exoplanet inference claim.
stop_invalidation: Wrong source hash/target/cadence/time convention, protocol drift or implementation bug invalidates affected run; preserve artifacts and amend before new ID.
freeze_requirements: Pre-acquisition target selection committed as recorded in selection_snapshot
All 15 exact sources have frozen SHA-256; new Kepler-4 acquisition manifest is content-addressed
This FROZEN full protocol must be committed before registration/execution; runner verifies unchanged HEAD bytes
Seeds derive from declared target identities; attempts preserve errors and never select by posterior quality
Protected scientific_003 and all historical paths remain byte-identical

selection_snapshot.note: Preserved immutable pre-acquisition selection snapshot; its inference DRAFT status is superseded only by this separate final protocol.

identity_policy.run_id: campaign ID + job ID + attempt index; safe lowercase ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen <=96 chars
identity_policy.source_checks: Verify every frozen FITS SHA-256 before and after preparation; no target replacement or source omission
identity_policy.historical_baseline: scientific_003 and historical RAW/Silver/Gold remain unchanged; new Gold is publication-isolated

sampler.missing_or_nonfinite: reject; convergence is necessary, not scientific validity

temporal_residuals.selected_pair_rule: Within each segment, selected-observation time[i+lag]-time[i] <= (lag+0.5)*median(diff(selected time)); the median selected gap is a spacing proxy, not original instrumental cadence
temporal_residuals.bound: abs(Pearson_r) <= norm.ppf(1 - 0.01/(2*5))/sqrt(pair_count); at least 11 pairs per evaluated lag
temporal_residuals.unavailable_policy: Nonfinite or degenerate correlations are null/unavailable. Positive PPC requires at least one finite evaluated lag; all lag-level availability is retained. No assessable lag cannot pass PPC.
temporal_residuals.limitations: Gap-filtered selected-observation lags are not necessarily contiguous original cadences after thinning. Normal-reference bounds are approximate for fitted residuals; unavailable lags and unobserved original-cadence correlation cannot be interpreted as absence of temporal structure.

physical.radius_review_semantics: Inherited M5 astrophysical review range, NOT LogNormal prior support boundaries.

gates.promotion: scientific requires all inherited sampler/PPC/physical/provenance rules plus publication temporal PPC; missing/failed/not_interpretable never promotes
gates.diagnostic_limitations: Thresholds are predeclared screening rules, not calibrated universal tests. Tree depth is reported diagnostically; no LOO ranking. Calibration/gate performance is investigated separately in PUB-02/PUB-04.

interval_definition: Equal-tailed posterior intervals at 50%,80%,94%; no observational coverage claim without known truth.
hypothesis_rejection: If the declared workflow cannot produce interpretable results in one or more regimes, restrict supported scope accordingly; five failures would reject a useful multi-regime applicability claim. Failure counts are not population rates.
publication_caveats: Five purposively selected systems are not an unbiased population sample.
Catalog ephemeris/duration influence folding and preprocessing; catalog posterior comparisons are contextual, not independent validation.
M5 has white jitter only; active-star temporal structure, fixed-period drift and occulted spots can legitimately cause rejection.
Thinning weakens high-frequency residual diagnostics and limits comparisons of nominal SNR across targets.
Segment median normalization uncertainty is not propagated.
r^2 is geometric depth, not observed limb-darkened transit depth.
